title: AC-Hunter 06: Multi-Protocol & Non-Standard Port Abuse (8443, 7844, 4444, 5985)
description: Detects C2 callbacks, RMM tunnels, and lateral movement over non-standard ports (8443, 7844, 4444, 5985, 8888) or application protocol mismatches across VCN Flow, Sysmon Network, and Network Firewall logs.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC VCN Flow Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Network Firewall Logs') and ('Destination Port' in (8443, 7844, 4444, 5985, 8888) or msg like '*protocol_mismatch*') | stats count as anomalous_port_flows, distinctcount('Destination Port') as non_standard_ports by 'Source IP', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Protocol' | where anomalous_port_flows >= 1 | sort -anomalous_port_flows

ask_ai_prompts: Which internal hosts are communicating over non-standard ports 8443, 7844, 4444, or 5985?
Identify any protocol mismatches on external egress connections.

falsepositives: Custom internal admin portals running on port 8443
investigation_notes: Port 7844 is default for Cloudflare Argo Tunnel (cloudflared); Port 8888/8443 are used by Caldera Sandcat and HTTPS C2 listeners; Port 5985 is WinRM.
Cross-reference with Sysmon process creation (Event ID 1) and Network Connection (Event ID 3).
